SELECT category, COUNT(*) as catCount 
FROM products
GROUP BY category
HAVING catCount >= 4
ORDER BY catCount DESC, category ASC

SELECT category, COUNT(*) as catCount 
FROM products
GROUP BY category
HAVING catCount >= 3
ORDER BY catCount DESC, category ASC

SELECT category, MAX(price) as highestPrice
FROM products
GROUP BY category
HAVING highestPrice > 10000 
ORDER BY category ASC

SELECT order_id, name, city, order_date
FROM ORDER_ITEMS o,
JOIN ORDERS or
ORDER BY order_date ASC, order_id ASC

SELECT o.order_id, c.name, c.city, or.order_date
FROM ORDER_ITEMS o,
JOIN ORDERS or
ON or.id - o.order_id
JOIN customers c
ON c.id = or.customer_id
ORDER BY order_date ASC, order_id ASC
